system.description:
Grants training or talent in a broad range of background skills.
Level 1: Developing - Gaining proficiency through regular application
Level 2: Trained - Moderate training and practice
Level 3: Expert - Significant training and practice
Level 4: Veteran - Extensive training and practice
Level 5: Master - Exhaustive training and practice
Level 6: Grand Master - Unparalleled ability and knowledge
